keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Alaves 1, Deportivo de A Coruña 0. Ángel Pérez (Alaves) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Antonio Blanco with a through ball.
Ximo Navarro (Deportivo de A Coruña) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Giacomo Quagliata (Deportivo de A Coruña) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ángel Pérez (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Nahuel Tenaglia, Alaves. Alaves 1, Deportivo de A Coruña 1.
First Half ends, Alaves 1, Deportivo de A Coruña 1.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Adama Traoré replaces Ximo Navarro.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. José María Giménez replaces Riki Rodríguez.
Second Half begins Alaves 1, Deportivo de A Coruña 1.
Miguel Loureiro (Deportivo de A Coruña) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Lucas Boyé (Alaves) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Leo Román (Deportivo de A Coruña).
Adama Traoré (Deportivo de A Coruña) is shown the yellow card.
Abde Rebbach (Alaves) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Lorenzo Amatucci replaces Mario Soriano.
Goal! Alaves 2, Deportivo de A Coruña 1. Lucas Boyé (Alaves) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ángel Pérez with a cross.
Lucas Boyé (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Jonathan Asp Jensen replaces Luismi Cruz.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Bil Nsongo replaces Yeremay Hernández.
Substitution, Alaves. Youssef Enriquez replaces Abde Rebbach.
Substitution, Alaves. Hugo Novoa replaces Ángel Pérez.
Substitution, Alaves. Mariano Díaz replaces Toni Martínez.
Substitution, Alaves. Ander Guevara replaces Pablo Ibáñez.
Delay in match because of an injury Hugo Novoa (Alaves).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Alaves. Xanet Oláiz replaces Hugo Novoa because of an injury.
Ander Guevara (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Alaves 3, Deportivo de A Coruña 1. Denis Suárez (Alaves) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lucas Boyé.
